fusions.name: Splash Fight
fusions.desc: Slaps up a sheet of water in a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything in it with a 50% chance to leave each target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pond Skipper
fusions.desc: Skips a flat pebble that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2 tiles, then skips on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that each.

fusions.name: Unruffled
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 12 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Shallows Stride

riders.text: you cross it faster than you cross ground
and blows slide off you while you are on it
and it gives something back while you rest on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you cross it 10% faster, from silver you have 8% more dodge chance while on it, and from gold your mana comes back 25% faster while on it.
